- **Airnet VPS** (`46.8.114.120`, `ubuntu`, SSH key `~/.ssh/voha_airnet`). Releases are atomic.
  - Each version lives in its own directory, `/var/www/voha-releases/<time>-<sha>/`; the live one is the `/var/www/voha-current` symlink.
  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.

  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.

h- **Airnet VPS** (`46.8.114.120`, `ubuntu`, SSH key `~/.ssh/voha_airnet`). Releases are atomic.
  - Each version lives in its own directory, `/var/www/voha-releases/<time>-<sha>/`; the live one is the `/var/www/voha-current` symlink.
  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.

  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.

  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.
- **Sale House** (Inventory API v1, `voha-residence.backend-salehouse.uz`): the site only reads apartment statuses, GET only (`lib/salehouse.ts`), Voha company only (`SALEHOUSE_SITE_COMPANY_ID`, default 1).
  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.
  - The 10-minute cron was not installed: the classifier blocked it, so it needs the owner's permission.

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.
- **Sale House** (Inventory API v1, `voha-residence.backend-salehouse.uz`): the site only reads apartment statuses, GET only (`lib/salehouse.ts`), Voha company only (`SALEHOUSE_SITE_COMPANY_ID`, default 1).
  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.
  - The 10-minute cron was not installed: the classifier blocked it, so it needs the owner's permission.

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.
- **Sale House** (Inventory API v1, `voha-residence.backend-salehouse.uz`): the site only reads apartment statuses, GET only (`lib/salehouse.ts`), Voha company only (`SALEHOUSE_SITE_COMPANY_ID`, default 1).
  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.
  - The 10-minute cron was not installed: the classifier blocked it, so it needs the owner's permission.

t- **Airnet VPS** (`46.8.114.120`, `ubuntu`, SSH key `~/.ssh/voha_airnet`). Releases are atomic.

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.
- **Sale House** (Inventory API v1, `voha-residence.backend-salehouse.uz`): the site only reads apartment statuses, GET only (`lib/salehouse.ts`), Voha company only (`SALEHOUSE_SITE_COMPANY_ID`, default 1).
  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.
  - The 10-minute cron was not installed: the classifier blocked it, so it needs the owner's permission.

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.
- **Sale House** (Inventory API v1, `voha-residence.backend-salehouse.uz`): the site only reads apartment statuses, GET only (`lib/salehouse.ts`), Voha company only (`SALEHOUSE_SITE_COMPANY_ID`, default 1).
  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.
  - The 10-minute cron was not installed: the classifier blocked it, so it needs the owner's permission.

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.
- **Sale House** (Inventory API v1, `voha-residence.backend-salehouse.uz`): the site only reads apartment statuses, GET only (`lib/salehouse.ts`), Voha company only (`SALEHOUSE_SITE_COMPANY_ID`, default 1).
  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.
  - The 10-minute cron was not installed: the classifier blocked it, so it needs the owner's permission.

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.
- **Sale House** (Inventory API v1, `voha-residence.backend-salehouse.uz`): the site only reads apartment statuses, GET only (`lib/salehouse.ts`), Voha company only (`SALEHOUSE_SITE_COMPANY_ID`, default 1).
  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.
  - The 10-minute cron was not installed: the classifier blocked it, so it needs the owner's permission.

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.
- **Sale House** (Inventory API v1, `voha-residence.backend-salehouse.uz`): the site only reads apartment statuses, GET only (`lib/salehouse.ts`), Voha company only (`SALEHOUSE_SITE_COMPANY_ID`, default 1).
  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.
  - The 10-minute cron was not installed: the classifier blocked it, so it needs the owner's permission.

  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.

  - Shared files are in `/var/www/voha-shared/`:
    - `.env.local`: Turso, `AUTH_SECRET`, `CRON_SECRET`, `SALEHOUSE_*`;
    - `uploads/`: admin-uploaded images; `public/uploads` in every release is a symlink to it;
    - `voha.config.js`: PM2, `cluster` with 2 instances, so `pm2 reload` causes no downtime.
  - `bash deploy/airnet.sh` ships the last commit into a new release (`npm ci` + build), switches the symlink and runs `pm2 reload`. The last 3 releases are kept. Rollback = point the symlink at the previous release + `pm2 reload voha`.
  - nginx: `/uploads/` → voha-shared/uploads, `/_next/static/` and `/cinema/` → voha-current.
  - `salehouse-bot.service` (the Sale House Telegram bot) and other PM2 apps (`quvonch-*`) also run on this server. Don't touch them.
- **Sale House** (Inventory API v1, `voha-residence.backend-salehouse.uz`): the site only reads apartment statuses, GET only (`lib/salehouse.ts`), Voha company only (`SALEHOUSE_SITE_COMPANY_ID`, default 1).
  - Admin flow at `/admin/salehouse`: "Solishtirish" builds a report in the background; "Qo'llash" writes the statuses to the site.
  - Prices are NOT pulled in (the owner's decision).
  - The token is entered on the server via `deploy/set-salehouse-token.sh` (hidden input). It is never written to chat or files.
  - The 10-minute cron was not installed: the classifier blocked it, so it needs the owner's permission.
